text: She rolled the dough into a long thin sheet.
translation: 她把面团擀成一张薄薄的长片。

text: He rolled the paper into a thin tube.
translation: 他把纸卷成细筒。

text: Roll the pastry flat and put it in the pan.
translation: 把面皮擀平放进烤盘。

text: They rolled the tent and put it away.
translation: 他们把帐篷卷起来收好。

text: The child rolled the ball under the bed.
translation: 孩子把球滚到床底下。

text: The ball rolled under the heavy bed.
translation: 球滚到重床底下去了。

text: She rolled down the hill on her old coat.
translation: 她裹着旧外套滚下了山坡。

text: The wheels rolled quietly on the wet road.
translation: 轮子在湿路上安静地滚动。

text: He rolled over twice and stood up.
translation: 他滚了两圈站起来。

text: The coin rolled right up to my foot.
translation: 硬币一直滚到我脚边。

text: Please read the roll of names very slowly.
translation: 请慢慢念这份名单。

text: The roll of the new members was on the wall.
translation: 新成员的名单在墙上。

text: He read the whole roll of numbers aloud.
translation: 他把整串数字大声念了出来。

text: Put your name at the top of the roll.
translation: 把你的名字写在名单最上面。

text: The roll of voters is kept by the clerk.
translation: 选民名单由书记员保管。

text: The clerk put the old case away in the roll.
translation: 书记员把旧案卷收起来。

text: His whole life is written in that roll.
translation: 他的一生都记在那卷档案里。

text: She found the paper roll under the desk.
translation: 她在桌子底下找到了那卷纸。

text: The old roll of letters was tied with string.
translation: 那卷旧信件用绳子捆着。

text: He read the whole roll from the first page.
translation: 他从第一页开始把整卷读完了。
